changeSet.comment: Update Rifabutin and Pyrazinamide NDR codes
changeSet.sql: UPDATE ndr_code_set SET ndr_code = CASE WHEN code_description = 'Rifabutin' AND code = 'RF' THEN 'NDRRF0206' WHEN code_description = 'Pyrazinamide (PZI)' AND code = 'Z' THEN 'NDRZ0192' ELSE ndr_code END WHERE (code_description = 'Rifabutin' AND code = 'RF') OR (code_description = 'Pyrazinamide (PZI)' AND code = 'Z');
